title: sarcocapnos integrifolia
intro: Sarcocapnos integrifolia, commonly known as Corydalis, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Papaveraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its potential to alleviate anxiety, insomnia, and pain, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
